name: Silicone Jelly Socks | Ultra-Moisturizing Gel Foot Care & Spa Therapy | Without Box
description:
Transform your foot care routine with Silicone Jelly Socks, designed to deeply moisturize, rejuvenate, and pamper your feet. Crafted from premium-quality silicone with a thick gel lining, these socks help restore softness, improve skin elasticity, and deliver spa-like nourishment at home. Infused with jojoba oil, botanical essential oils, and vitamin E, they provide long-lasting hydration while enhancing absorption of skincare products and treatments. Lightweight, soft, and stretchable, they fit most men’s and women’s foot sizes for a comfortable self-care experience.
Key Features:
 Ultra-moisturizing gel lining for deep hydration
 Enriched with jojoba oil, botanical oils & vitamin E
 Softens rough heels & improves skin elasticity
 Comfortable stretchable design fits most sizes
 Enhances absorption of creams & treatments
 Lightweight, soft, non-toxic & reusable
How to Use:
 Wash and dry feet before use
 Wear socks for 20–40 minutes (or overnight if preferred)
 Use 3–4 times a week for best results
 Hand wash gently with mild soap and air dry
Ingredients:
Silicone Gel, Jojoba Oil, Botanical Essential Oils, Vitamin E
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Do not use on open wounds or broken skin
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Keep away from heat and direct sunlight
Package Includes:
 1 × Pair of Silicone Jelly Socks (Without Box)
